nodes.label: Full-Stack Context Inspection Rule
nodes.rationale: Always inspect both backend/ and frontend/ before developing features or bugfixes, to understand full context and avoid duplication. Rationale: features spanning both tiers drift in API shape, types and naming unless data flow is traced through both folders first; reuse is preferred over new endpoints/components/types.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS + Catalyst UI Styling Mandate
nodes.rationale: All UI must use Tailwind CSS for styling and Catalyst UI for core component structure, to maintain visual consistency and code quality. Deviations are allowed only with a strong reason documented in the code.

nodes.label: Structured Logging Policy
nodes.rationale: Bare console.log/console.error are banned; use a leveled logger (winston/pino on Node backend, @sentry/browser or loglevel on frontend) centralized in a shared module such as /lib/logger.js. Rationale: ad hoc logging leaks sensitive data (passwords, tokens, PII), loses level semantics, and cannot be configured per environment.

nodes.label: Shared Library Extraction Rule
nodes.rationale: Complex or widely useful logic must be extracted into a shared lib/utils directory (e.g. /frontend/src/lib) rather than embedded in deeply nested components or backend routes, so it can be imported instead of duplicated.
